descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S05 「还没有测试断言的协议格子：接受之前的服务器拦截、Decline 之后重用会话、错的浏览器时钟、界面上看运维的改动、养老院里的 Decline」 Agreements cells no test asserts yet: the server gate before acceptance, a session reused after Decline, a wrong browser clock, an operator change on screen, Decline in Nursing Home

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 On first sign-in, before any AI feature can be used, one agreements screen shows: the AI consent, links to the Terms of Use and the BAA, and two checkboxes (the agreement and the authorization attest …（UAT OAT-01 step 7；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94700 AC 7；TFA-94700 AC 8；TFA-94700 AC 9；TFA-94700 AC 11；UAT 3.3）
  • T5 Sign out ends the session. The physician must sign in again with an email code.（TFA-94700 AC 2）
  • T6 The consent and agreements screen comes back when the AI provider list changes, or when the document version is changed in Convex. The re-acceptance is stored.（TFA-94700 AC 10；TFA-94700 AC 11）
  • U11 The agreement acceptance is saved with the physician, a timestamp, the document version and both checkbox acceptances.（UAT OAT-01 step 10；TFA-94700 AC 10；TFA-94700 AC 11）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Run serially on an isolated local stack, because cell (d) changes the shared legalAgreements row. Brand-new @roundai.test accounts signed in through the real form or the API. The model call is intercepted (e2e/support/action-observer.ts), so no live AI call is made.

When (a) A fresh account that never accepted calls ai/assist:askChart and a rounding create directly. (b) Press Decline, then reuse the old session token for settings:get. (c) A Playwright context with page.clock.install at server time + 2 d and timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu' accepts the agreements. …

Then (a) Both calls are refused before the model is called, and nothing is stored (per Q15). (b) The call answers 'session missing', as for a revoked session. (c) acceptedAt falls inside the runner's server-time bracket, not 2 days ahead. (d) The screen comes back showing 'QA attestation v2', and Continue stores a row with documentVersion '2026-11-01'. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U7 (gate before any AI feature; Decline signs out; the same in Nursing Home, AC 7), T5 (Decline ends the session: sign in again with a code), T6 (a version change in Convex prompts re-acceptance, AC 11), U11 (server timestamp, UAT 3.8). A hard-coded version or attestation fails (d). …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-a。

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S05

Agreements cells no test asserts yet: the server gate before acceptance, a session reused after Decline, a wrong browser clock, an operator change on screen, Decline in Nursing Home

Tickets: TFA-94700 Physician Settings & AI Consent (store requirements) (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-a：newspec-a/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（newspec-a/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New spec, one test per cell, fresh account each: (a) direct ai/assist:askChart + rounding:add before acceptance (askChart is refused only if a consent gate exists; a refusal message is required, and the patient list must stay empty); (b) Decline in the browser, wait for the /sign-out response, then settings:get with the old JWT and Better Auth get-session with the old token, on a form sign-in and again on an injected session; (c) browser context with page.clock at server+2 d and timezoneId Pacific/Honolulu ticks both boxes and presses Continue, acceptedAt read with agreements:_acceptancesForTests and compared with a server-time bracket (time:now before/after); (d) operator agreements:_set to version 2026-11-01 + attestation 'QA attestation v2' on an ISOLATED backend I start myself (the row is deployment-wide), reload, screen text, Continue, stored documentVersion; (e) settings:update appMode snf before the UI sign-in, screen with both boxes unticked + Continue disabled, Decline lands on sign-in and stores no acceptance. — All cells are server calls or browser steps on the local stack; (d) only needs its own backend so the shared stack's other jobs never see a version change. Cell (a) deviates from the matrix 'given': action-observer.ts intercepts only browser websocket traffic and so could not show a SERVER gate, the shared backend has no model stub and convex env set is forbidden, so (a) makes one bounded live Haiku call per run (3 so far) and aiCallLog records that the action reached the provider step.

Detail:

(b) Decline, then reuse after the /sign-out response: a session signed in through the form AND an injected session are both refused: sign-out 200 carrying this session's cookie, settings:get with the old JWT -> 'Not authenticated: session missing', Better Auth get-session -> null (final2 + 3 repeats each in s05b-repeat). (c) accepted on a browser at server+2 d, Pacific/Honolulu: acceptedAt inside the server-time bracket, not the device's date. (d) isolated backend: after agreements:_set {version 2026-11-01, attestation 'QA attestation v2'} the reload shows the consent screen with 'QA attestation v2', Continue disabled until both ticks, Continue stores documentVersion 2026-11-01; row restored. (e) Nursing Home (appMode snf before sign-in): identical screen text to Hospital, 2 boxes unticked, Continue disabled with none or one ticked, Decline -> sign-in screen, no acceptance and no aiConsentVersion stored. RECORD-ONLY (a), Q15: for an account that never accepted, ai/assist:askChart was ANSWERED (aiCallLog: assist.askChart, Haiku 4.5, ok) and rounding:add STORED a patient - the gate is on the screen only. Deviation from the matrix 'given': (a) made a live model call (1 per run, 3 in total) instead of an intercepted one; see the patch. Observation, not a verdict: in 1 of 7 injected-session runs, made while the shared backend was timing functions out (rerun-under-load.log, test '(b, injected session)'), sign-out answered 200 {success:true} yet the session stayed valid. Better Auth 1.5.6's sign-out catches a failed deleteSession and still answers success (node_modules/.../better-auth/dist/api/routes/sign-out.mjs), which would explain it; not reproduced in 6 later runs, backend log not captured.

只记录（recordOnly）：(a) Q15: whether the server must refuse AI calls and PHI writes before acceptance
